152 likes, 61 comments - simrun.chopra on October 7, 2026: "How to feel full on a diet and lose weight ? 

Nearly zero calorie foods im listing them by claories. 
Also if youre serious about weight loss start by upping your protein in breakfast to reduce cravings through the day. 

Comment "breakfast" and ill send you a 100 high protein breakfast ideas with over 20 gms peotein under 400 cals. 

Now zero cal foods are basically super low claories so its a great way to eat more without adding calories. 

If you like large meals like me add 1 cup of any of these at the start of your meal 

These 10 foods with almost zero calories 

Cucumber 1 cup 16 calories 
Spinach 1 cup : 7 calories 
Zucchini 1 cup cooked : 19 calories 
Tomatoes  1 cup : 32 calories 
Mushrooms 1 cup cooked : 44 calories 
Or make my Konjak noodles : 100 gms 9 calories 
Comment noodles and ill send you the recipe 

For snacks try
Watermelon 1 cup: 47 calories 
Plain homemade popcorn 1 cup 30 calories 
Home corn with little oil : 1 cup 35 calories 
Black coffee no sugar : 2 calories

Hope this helps 
Love 
Sim".
